description: This file defines a serializer class for converting JavaScript values into a structured format suitable for communication in a browser automation context, including handling of special types like RegExp, Date, and circular objects.

classes.name: UnserializableError
classes.description: Custom error class used internally to indicate serialization issues.

classes.name: BidiSerializer
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to serialize various JavaScript data types into a structured format.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript value into a Bidi.Script.LocalValue format, handling different types accordingly.

methods.name: _serializeNumber
methods.description: Serializes a number, including special cases like -0, Infinity, -Infinity, and NaN.

methods.name: _serializeObject
methods.description: Serializes objects, arrays, RegExp, Date, and handles circular references.
